stories.headline: Nabers Dodges the Laid-Up List, and Week 1 Is Back on the Table
stories.read: Word down the New York wire, pardner: Malik Nabers busted his knee wide open back in Week 4, but the Giants left him clean off the laid-up list to open camp, and now ridin' Week 1 ain't a pipe dream no more. The whole saloon's been shovin' this young gun down the board on injury jitters, spookin' the herd right when a smart hand oughta be strikin'. That's a top-shelf pass-catcher sittin' at a knocked-down price, and that's exactly the vein you pan before your leaguemates wise up. Just keep one eye on him come September, 'cause he ain't promised to saddle up if that wheel don't feel right.

stories.headline: Tuten Grabs the Reins in Jacksonville, and He's Cheap Gold
stories.read: Here's your diamond in the rough, pardner. Travis Etienne rode off to New Orleans, and the fella lined up to take the whole Jaguars backfield is young Bhayshul Tuten, a second-year burner who shook off more tacklers than near 'bout anybody his rookie go-round. His one rival for the job, Chris Rodriguez, is laid up nursin' a busted foot, so Tuten's runnin' clean away with the reins and the workload. Volume is king out here on the Trail, so stake your claim on that cheap gold before the herd stampedes.

stories.headline: Taylor Might Dig In His Heels Over a New Deal, but Don't You Spook
stories.read: Chatter out of Indianapolis, pardner: Jonathan Taylor's jawin' over a fresh contract, and some folks reckon he might dig in at camp till the money's right. Now a greenhorn'll read that headline and go joggin' scared, but rein it in. The Colts ain't got a lick of a backup plan, so this workhorse still totes the mail come Sunday no matter how the deal shakes out. Don't let a little saloon gossip cost you an elite runner at a discount, that's fool's gold panic if I ever saw it.
